data.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Houthi Attacks on Civilian Facilities in Riyadh, Calls on International Community to Fulfill Responsibilities
data.content:
Riyadh, November 19, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's strong condemnation of the Houthi militia's continued terrorist attacks targeting civilian and economic facilities and civilian objects in Riyadh, which caused material damage in King Abdullah Financial District.
    "The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia asserts its full and legitimate right to take all necessary measures to defend its sovereignty, protect its national assets, and safeguard the security and safety of its citizens and residents. It will not tolerate any aggression targeting its territory or assets, in accordance with the principles of international law," the ministry said in a statement.
    "The Kingdom calls upon the international community and the permanent members of the UN Security Council to fulfill their responsibilities, implement relevant Security Council resolutions, and condemn the heinous attacks carried out by the Houthi terrorist militia against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia—attacks that underscore the threat this terrorist militia poses to the security of the region and the world," it added.
    -- SPA
